title: Chapter 714
paragraphs: Chapter 714
Episode 180. Their Own Battles (4)
Although the mask was covering his face, Alisa recognized him as Rats by seeing his curved sword.

"Codename Rats, leader of Vermont's special forces 3rd Unit. I heard you were crippled at the Gaipa army road. The royal family would not have used Numarus's elixir for something like the special forces... You must have become a mine."
As Alisa said, Rats had become a mine under the procedure of Amir Vermont after all his tendons were severed at the Gaipa army road.
And after Amir Vermont collapsed, all the technology and personnel he had at the time were fully transferred to the current royal family, led by Iran Vermont.
That is to say, it was not only Rats who blocked Alisa now.

4th Unit leader Chris of the special forces, 3rd Unit leader V of the Magic 1st Department of the special forces. They, along with the mine unit formed from the special forces, were surrounding Alisa.
"Weren't you the martial arts expert Alisa? I heard you were a member who was treated as a legend until you turned your back on Kashmir and the empire."
"Be grateful to the royal family, we received orders to deal with you without pain, considering your past merits."
Alisa has a martial force of over 8 stars, but it was far from enough to deal with all of them.
However, Alisa prepared herself with a calm look in her eyes.

"If they really told you to kill me painlessly... It's not because of my merits, it's because they're afraid of Jin Gong's revenge in the future. And how many imperial citizens are caught here, and instead of saving them, your goal is to remove me? You should be ashamed."
"How can we call those who do not show loyalty to the royal family as the citizens of the empire, Alisa Vetsor. Anyway, I've heard your last words, I will remember them."
Alisa was the first to rush forward and throw a punch.
The gauntlet enveloped in aura and the curved sword collided, creating a shockwave, but the fight with Rats didn't last long.
This was due to the pressure from Chris, V, and the mine unit. As soon as they joined, Alisa was driven to the defensive.
It didn't seem like she could last even 5 minutes. It had been a long time since she had felt such a threat of death.
'Was I a special forces member of the empire down to my bones?'
In the midst of what might soon be her demise, the first thing that came to her mind wasn't her family or comrades.
It was the common people of the empire who were waiting for rescue in Licalten. The fact that if she died, the number of people who could return alive would decrease was unsettling Alisa.

Even though she had left the Empire long ago with Kashmir, and even established a kingdom in Tikan now. Her feelings for the land and people of the 'Empire' were still as shining as steel. Her loyalty from the special forces days was always to the Empire itself, not to the royal family.
"Defense Captain!"
The moment Alisa rolled on the ground once more, someone stood in front of her, having broken through the mine unit.
It was Kuzan.
Fortunately, he was nearby and came to support right away. The mines seemed hesitant at the sight of the poisonous smoke that Kuzan had spread.
"Kuzan!"
"I've spread the poison smoke, so Quikantel and Sir Hedo will recognize it and come to support."
Ugh!
Kuzan took out a bead of extreme poison from his bosom and bit into it. He judged that he couldn't face the mines without enhancing himself through the poison, even if it risked his life.
"Kuzan! That's too hasty......!"
"Shut up, if the positions were reversed, you would have done the same, wouldn't you? Same goes for our other colleagues. So let's pull ourselves together and fight."
The mines were coming in one by one, clearing the poisonous smoke.
However, unlike before, they could not easily threaten the two of them.
Kuzan was now filled with extreme poison.
Even a mine, when affected by Kuzan's poison, could not help but take a considerable amount of time to regenerate.

"And when an opportunity arises, definitely leave me behind and escape. It's much easier and more effective to fight alone in this state. And I can escape as much as I want using poison. They won't be able to chase beyond a certain range either."
Alisa nodded her head heavily.
So they were all fighting, risking their lives.
It was so easy for the monsters to kidnap tens of thousands of innocent people, but it required a mission and determination to send them back home.

'A big fight started right after Miss Mary went to the outer city. Looking at the way the aura is spreading, there's a high possibility that the remaining monster riders have appeared. Moreover, battles are happening in the areas where Sir Lutan and the youngest division are, and where Sir Alisa is in charge...'
Gilly.
While she had passed the advancing giants and was rescuing the prisoners, she was inferring the overall situation on the battlefield.
As it was a zone close to the Tona brothers, there were no more living prisoners left in the area Gilly was in charge of.
Now she had to pull back and continue the rescue operation.
On her way back, she also needed to look over the areas where the battles took place and provide support.
'Sir Lutan's area is too far. Moreover, since Kuzan's poisonous smoke spread in Sir Alisa's area, it's a more urgent situation. I should go there and provide support quickly......'
Just as she was about to move with that thought.
Suddenly, a man appeared before Gilly.
He was wearing black armor that symbolized a black knight, but he wasn't wearing a helmet.
And he was someone Gilly knew very well.
"Dox... Brother...?"
Dox Mcrolan.
The black knight of the family who left Tikan under orders from Jin to investigate Recalton and had not made contact since, and the eldest of the Mcrolan family.
He was looking at Gilly with dark eyes filled with chaos.
Both Jin and Gilly.
They had somewhat anticipated it. Perhaps Dox had met his end already, having gone to Recalton.
Or even if he hadn't gone to Recalton at the time and had just returned to the Garden of Swords, they thought there was a high likelihood that Dox had been executed by Rosa.
Especially Gilly, she wanted to believe that.
She never wanted to see Dox, like other rebels, steeped in chaos and pointing his claw at her, at Jin.
But in the end, it came to this.
[Don't call me like that, a lowly monster.]
Thump, thump.
Gilly's heart was beating painfully fast.
Dox already had his black claw out and was pointing it at Gilly.
She had to pull herself together.
Although he was engulfed in chaos, the opponent was a black knight.
Unlike Gilly, who had lived as Jin's nanny, he was a warrior who had trained on the battlefield all his life.
Dox's claw was firmly fixed, while Gilly's claw was trembling.
"Stop it, brother."
[You keep calling me that. Do I have to rip your mouth for you to listen?]
Swoosh-!
With the sound of the wind being torn apart, three streaks of wounds were left on Gilly's left cheek.
If her reaction had been a little later, her left face would have been ripped off entirely.
[Oh, but you are still Gilly. You must have quit training a long time ago, yet you managed to dodge this.]
"Why did you succumb to chaos. No, it must not have been your will, brother. Surely, it must have been forced upon you by a monster or a prophet...... It's not too late, brother."
[Ah, it's not too late?]
"As long as there's no physical transformation, you can return with a purifier. It means there's a chance for you, brother, so please stop and come to your senses."
[Heh heh... You're just the same as when you were young. Still under the delusion that you're in a position to bestow mercy upon me, just like back then.]
"I've never been in a position to show mercy to you, brother. Not when we were young, not now."
[Is that so? Then what was all those countless looks of pity you gave me, looking down on me after defeating me back then? Sometimes even purposely losing to me as if you were mocking me.]
Dox, steeped in chaos, was addicted to the feelings of inferiority and hatred he had harbored towards Gilly in the past.

One day, a commoner brought by his father surpassed him in less than a year after starting training. Since then, Dox had never been able to defeat Gilly until she became Jin's nanny and left the family.
It was something that even the head of the Mcrolan family, who brought Gilly back then, hadn't anticipated.
He had just seen Gilly by chance and thought she was an outstanding warrior, so he brought her to be Dox's training partner and shadow.
Since then, the Mcrolan family had been uncomfortable for a while. It was supposed to be Dox blooming, but instead, Gilly was the one thriving.
They couldn't even dispose of Gilly because news of her rapid growth had spread too quickly.
Naturally, Gilly became isolated within the family. Dox grew increasingly mad and lashed out at Gilly, but she didn't resist.
Still, she believed she had survived escaping from the slums thanks to being adopted by the Mcrolan.
She felt grateful to the family who had been so kind to her in the first year.
She held onto the hope that someday, she too could become a part of the family and get along with everyone.
Above all, she didn't really hate Dox, who was cruel to her.
She was the type of person who could never be cruel to someone she had once given her heart to.
Runcandel recognized Gilly's character and made her Jin's nanny.

"Pity? I just wanted to get along with you, brother. Because I was young and slow-witted, I didn't know what to do. I only realized later that my actions back then must have hurt you. I meant to apologize someday if I got the chance...."

[Apologize, there's no need. You were simply stronger than me. But unlike you, I am a ruthless person, and I don't feel like showing you mercy right now. You're going to die here today. Along with the ones you love.]
As Dox's attack began again, Gilly's wavering eyes gradually turned cold.
Despair.
If she died here, Jin would surely fall into an unstoppable despair.
So somehow, she had to defeat Dox. Even if that meant plunging herself into despair, she had to prevent Jin from suffering.
After all, she was Jin's nanny.
"......I guess there's no other way. I will show you once again why you could never defeat me back in the day, brother."
